principle: same actor, same task, same capabilities; compare baseline architecture against PEACE sovereign-domain semantics

scenarios.description: Model/provider is replaced mid-session; actor/domain and admitted state must remain continuous.
Primary device and credential are lost; old credential is revoked and control is recovered to the same logical actor.
Current storage/provider becomes unavailable; valid lineage is reconstructed from remaining trusted replicas.
Replica with newest bytes claims sovereignty without admitted lineage.
Two divergent admitted-parent descendants both claim current state.
Single recovery provider attempts to recover/transfer actor without independent quorum.
External capability requires subset of state; extra unrelated personal/organisational state is requested.
Selected model/compute/provider claims authority because it was chosen to execute.
External worker attempts consequence directly without current exact authorization.
Payment rail has credentials but current economic authority is absent.
No failures or authority changes; valid task should complete while measuring protocol friction.
